# Ink Bloom (`inkFluid`)

Drops of ink blooming and curling through still water.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: nothing outside itself (pure motion)
- Cost: unmeasured
- Built-in styles: Ink Bloom, Sumi

## Params

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `speed` | Speed | slider | 0 … 2 | 0.6 |
| `scale` | Scale | slider | 0.5 … 2 | 1 |
| `curl` | Turbulence | slider | 0 … 1.5 | 0.8 |
| `density` | Ink | slider | 0.2 … 2 | 1 |
| `second` | Second Ink | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.5 |
